# Box

`ui.box` · parts: `Box` · elements: `<div>`

## Purpose

Box is the polymorphic structural primitive. `tag` accepts HTML5 structural
elements only (sections, lists, tables, fieldset); anything else falls back to div.
Forms use the Form primitive (Box no longer accepts `form`).

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
- Prefer semantic tags (`section`, `nav`, `ul`, …) over `div` when the content has meaning.
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Box renders the requested structural HTML element (default div).

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Tag` | `tag` | `tag` | `"div" \| "section" \| "article" \| "aside" \| "header" \| "footer" \| "main" \| "nav" \| "figure" \| "search" \| "ul" \| "ol" \| "li" \| "dl" \| "dt" \| "dd" \| "fieldset" \| "table" \| "thead" \| "tbody" \| "tfoot" \| "tr" \| "th" \| "td" \| "caption" \| "colgroup" \| "col"` | — | prop | HTML5 structural tag (default div) |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in UI frameworks, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- No ARIA attributes are rendered by the primitive; rely on native semantics. Pass extra `aria-*` through attrs.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `boxClasses({ ... })` from `box/box.shared.ts` |
| templ | `box.BoxClasses(box.BoxProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('boxClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::boxClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `box_classes(p)` |

React additionally supports `asChild` (merges props onto the single child via [Slot](slot.md)).

## Usage

Fixture `section` (`{"Tag":"section","Class":"p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<section class="p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground">Content</section>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Box } from "./ui/box/box";

<Box tag="section" className="p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground">Content</Box>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "./ui/box/Box.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Box tag="section" class="p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground">Content</Box>
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "./ui/box/Box.svelte";
</script>

<Box tag="section" class="p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground">Content</Box>
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Box } from "./ui/box/box.solid";

<Box tag="section" class="p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground">Content</Box>
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderBox } from "./ui/box/box.wc";

document.body.append(renderBox({ tag: "section", class: "p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground" }, "Content"));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ
@box.Box(box.BoxProps{Tag: "section", Class: "p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground"}) {
	Content
}
```
